name: io.github.caelo-cms/caelo
title: Caelo CMS
description: Edit a self-hosted Caelo CMS site from your agent. Changes land in a draft; a human publishes.

packageArguments.description: Pass 'admin' for Power-MCP (the full tool catalogue, needs an admin-scoped token). Omit for caelo_chat.

environmentVariables.name: CAELO_ADMIN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Caelo admin's https:// address, e.g. https://admin.example.com

environmentVariables.name: CAELO_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: MCP token minted at /settings/mcp on your install

environmentVariables.name: CAELO_IAP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Only for Google Cloud (IAP) installs; /settings/mcp shows the value
